title: Fig Props Up the Nest
note: b414 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters pr, sc, sk.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar spotting a small twig nest resting unevenly on a branch.
Close view of the nest tilted at an angle on the branch, not sitting flat.
Fig the caterpillar wedging a thin stick underneath the tilted nest.
The nest tipping sideways off the thin stick.
Fig the caterpillar finding a flat grey rock on the ground.
Fig the caterpillar wedging the flat grey rock underneath the nest instead.
The nest now resting flat and steady on the branch.
Fig the caterpillar climbing nimbly up to the now-steady nest.
Fig the caterpillar curled up asleep inside the steady nest.
